positions.title: Senior Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Team lead for the front-end development of the UI Platform and Timekeeping on Workforce Dimensions.  Development targets all device breakpoints using Javascript, Typescript, Angular, AngularJS, Node.js, redis, redux, webpack, grunt, karma, mocha, lodash, etc... using TDD and Design Patterns.  Experience improving performance with complex user interface solutions in a cloud environment.

Developer working with the Mobile team on iOS, Android, and Workforce Central web service extensions supporting the mobile platforms.   Development targeting iPad, iPhone, and Android devices using Java, Objective C, REST, JBoss, MSSQL, Eclipse, Ant, Agile, Test-Driven Development, and Design Patterns.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · User Experience (UX) · HTML · Front-End Development · AngularJS · HTML5

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer working on EMC SourceOne with a focus on EMC Offline Access for Microsoft Outlook.  Experience with Microsoft Outlook and Exchange 2003, 2007, and 2010.  Technology areas include C#/.NET, COM, C++, Web Services, MAPI, OOM, MS Office Add-in, OWA, and EWS.
